name: Soltec Power Holdings, S.A.
summary: Soltec Power Holdings, S.A. engages in the development of solutions for photovoltaic energy projects in Spain, Chile, the United States, Brazil, Peru, Mexico, Argentina, Australia, India, Italy, France, China, Colombia, Portugal, and Romania. The company offers products, including SFOne, a dual-row single-axis solar tracker; Agrovoltaic; and the SF7 bifacial two-in-portrait vertical tracker. It also promotes, developing, constructing and maintaining electric power generating plants, including manufacture, supply, installation, and assembly of industrial equipment and facilities for solar plants. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Murcia, Spain.
